title: REQ: Freeze exception for Sr SWE backfill — Q1 headcount tradeoff
text:
REQ: Freeze exception for Sr SWE backfill — Q1 headcount tradeoff

['From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: REQ: Freeze exception for Sr SWE backfill — Q1 headcount tradeoff

Team —

Requesting a freeze exception to backfill a departing Senior Software Engineer on Platform (IC-4). Context: the engineer gave notice effective 2/28; their work owns the v2 caching path that is critical for multiple Hosted customers and a dedicated pipeline for an enterprise trial next month. I ran the HC tradeoff ledger in the attached Headcount_Impact_Req.pdf (summary attached) and recommend we convert an upcoming Contractor slot into a permanent backfill rather than delay.

Why this is time-sensitive:
- Ramp gap will create measurable latency regressions for two Hosted customers if not addressed within 6–8 weeks.
- Q1 product milestone (regional cache rollout) depends on this ownership.
- We have a high-quality candidate pipeline from a recruiting agency (linked below).

Asks:
1) PeopleOps: confirm comp band and quick turn on job posting (Monica).
2) Leadership: approval for a freeze exception and permission to reallocate one Contractor slot to permanent HC (Vivek/Marissa).
3) Hiring manager: Aditya to confirm role scope and immediate priorities.

Attachments: Headcount_Impact_Req.pdf, org_chart_v2.png

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
', 'From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: REQ: Freeze exception for Sr SWE backfill — Q1 headcount tradeoff

Laura —

Got it. I pulled the comp band matrix and initial approval flow; two quick questions before I can push this through PeopleOps:
1) Compensation: what target band and expected offer range? I need the number to check against the current salary plan and to run a fast market check with Ellen Price (comp consultant).
2) Duration: are you proposing to convert the existing Contractor headcount this quarter permanently, or is this a one-year renewable hire?

If you can confirm both, I can prepare the HC change request and routing (to Finance for budget sign-off, then to Vivek for exception approval). I can also share the Greenhouse req draft and loop the recruiting partner for expedited sourcing.

Per policy, freeze exceptions require sign-off from the org head (Vivek) and Finance. If this is urgent, flag it "Critical impact to SLOs" and I'll mark the ticket for expedited routing.

—Monica
People Operations
Redwood Inference

On Sat, Feb 14, 2026 at 09:15 AM Laura Bennett wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Requesting a freeze exception to backfill a departing Senior Software Engineer on Platform (IC-4)...
', "From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: REQ: Freeze exception for Sr SWE backfill — Q1 headcount tradeoff

Laura / Monica —

Supporting this exception. Quick notes from the team side:
- Impact: Without backfill, we will be ~40% under coverage for the v2 caching lane during the critical two sprint window in March — that increases regression risk for hosted customers and forces deprioritization of non-critical backlog that the product team expects in the next release.
- Work to transfer: knowledge transfer requires 2x focused weeks (doc + pair sessions). We have a senior SWE on the Release team who can take temporary pager rotation, but can't cover the product work.
- Scope: I recommend hiring a Senior SWE (IC-4) with infra/caching experience; compensation target: $180k–$200k base, total comp ~ $210k–$240k US range (see comp_band_and_approval.xlsx attached).

If the Contractor slot is converted to permanent HC, we can start interviewing immediately; the recruiter has two screened candidates ready for interviews. If Finance requires cost neutral solution, we can propose delaying a planned Q2 hire in Analytics as a tradeoff.

—Aditya
Engineering Manager, Platform

On Sat, Feb 14, 2026 at 10:02 AM Monica Patel wrote:
> Laura —
> 
> Got it. I pulled the comp band matrix...
", 'From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: REQ: Freeze exception for Sr SWE backfill — Q1 headcount tradeoff

Thanks for the clear write-up — I approve a conditional freeze exception for one permanent Senior SWE backfill, subject to the following conditions:
1) Budget: Finance must verify the reallocation of the Contractor slot cost to permanent HC for FY26 (Monica to route to Finance).
2) Tradeoff: we will delay the Analytics Q2 hire until Septer (or until we fill this backfill) — please update the HC ledger with the exact cost swap and publish in Confluence.
3) Speed: Recruiting should prioritize internal and agency candidates; first round interviews to be scheduled within 7 business days.
4) Risk mitigation: Aditya to provide a 2-week transition plan and list of critical deliverables that must be maintained during onboarding.

Monica — please route the HC change request (attach comp_band_and_approval.xlsx) and include Ellen Price for expedited comp verification. Laura / Aditya — proceed with the job posting and interview loops. If Finance pushes back, come back with the precise cost-neutral options.

—Vivek
CTO
Redwood Inference
', 'From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Hiring Partner <recruit@hirepartners.io>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: REQ: Freeze exception for Sr SWE backfill — Q1 headcount tradeoff

Vivek / Monica —

Thanks for the timely review and conditional approval. Action items I will own:
- Publish updated HC ledger and cost-swap notes to Confluence (link: https://confluence.redwood/team/headcount-planning/Q1-2026) by EOD 2/17.
- Share the 2-week transition plan and list of critical deliverables (Aditya has a draft; I will finalize).
- Post the Greenhouse req and kick off interview scheduling with the recruiter today.

Monica — please route to Finance for the cost reallocation sign-off and loop Ellen Price for comp validation. Hiring Partner — please prioritize the two screened candidates and provide availability for interview next week.

Attachments: comp_band_and_approval.xlsx

—Laura
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
']
